svg.text: A spine with standard sockets; any mix of modules, several of each kind. Each Dock holds a different battleship, each Mfg a different product
ONI SPACEWAR · exploratory concept · not a decided art direction
Add a module to any free socket → the carrier grows. Duplicates allowed: 3 Docks = 3 battleships ready.
Docking modules — one battleship each, each with its own mechanic
Manufacturing modules — same room type, different production line
Product names, ship roles and socket count are placeholders — the point is the structure: modules are repeatable building blocks.
Build area = sum of module interiors (each still Mindustry-style inside, bounded by its walls).
